hook.line: A medieval sword was never cast. It was forged from a bar of iron.
hook.idea: the cast in one frame, close enough that the eye has nowhere else to go
hook.demands: the strongest, most specific image available — never a texture, never a stand-in

ending.line: Two hundred hours of work, and the design is entirely in how fast it cooled.
ending.idea: the closing claim, typographic and still
ending.demands: one shot: the strongest relevant image, the claim over it, then a hold and a hard out
